Differentiate between Makkan and Madinan Surah. (10 marks)

State six reasons why the Prophet (P2b.u.h) emphasized on the recording of the Quran

Give seven reasons why mankind needed the revelation of the Quran. (7 marks)
Mention five teachings of Surah Al-Fatihah. (5 marks)
Discuss the characteristics of the chain of narrators (Isnaad) of a Sahih hadith.

(7 marks)
Explain the significance of hadith in the life of a Muslim. (7 marks)

The Prophet (P-b.xh) said “Do not be angry”.
